datasets.name: Marion County Indiana Boundary
datasets.purpose: Defines the project study-area boundary and supports clipping and coverage checks.
datasets.source_organization: City of Indianapolis and Marion County

license.name: No explicit license supplied in ArcGIS service metadata
license.notes: Publicly queryable official service. Raw responses are cached locally and are not redistributed by this repository; confirm downstream republication terms before release.

datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 in requested GeoJSON; source service reports WKID 2244 / latest WKID 2965
known_limitations: The service does not publish a clear open-data license in its layer metadata.
This administrative boundary is not itself a neighborhood reporting geography.
datasets.manual_fallback: Open the source page URL, choose Query, request all records with geometry and output spatial reference 4326, select GeoJSON output, and save the response as marion_county_boundary.geojson.

datasets.name: 2024 TIGER/Line Indiana Census Block Groups
datasets.purpose: Provides stable small-area geography and GEOIDs for later population joins and neighborhood-scale reporting comparisons.

license.name: U.S. Census Bureau public data
license.notes: Census Bureau employee-created data generally are not subject to U.S. copyright; cite the Census Bureau and the vintage.

datasets.geographic_coverage: State of Indiana; later processing will select county FIPS 097
known_limitations: Block groups are Census statistical areas, not resident-defined neighborhoods.
Statewide data require a later county filter and projected-CRS transformation before distance or area analysis.
datasets.manual_fallback: Visit the TIGER/Line 2024 page, open Census Block Groups, download the Indiana file tl_2024_18_bg.zip, and place it in the configured raw cache with that exact filename.

datasets.name: IndyGo Static GTFS Schedule
datasets.purpose: Supplies official transit stops, routes, trips, stop times, service calendars, and shapes for later transit-access and network-method work.

license.name: IndyGo Developer Content Terms of Use
license.notes: Use is subject to IndyGo terms, including as-is availability, copyright, termination, and mark restrictions. The repository stores no production feed.

datasets.geographic_coverage: IndyGo scheduled service in Indianapolis and surrounding service area
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 coordinates in stops.txt and shapes.txt per GTFS
known_limitations: The official developer page requires review and acceptance of terms through a request form even though the operational static-feed endpoint was publicly reachable when verified.
The feed is a changing schedule snapshot and does not prove service operated as scheduled.
Feed validity dates must be checked at analysis time.
datasets.manual_fallback: Review the terms and submit IndyGo's GTFS Data Request form at the license URL. Save the supplied unmodified ZIP as indygo_gtfs.zip in the configured cache, then run the CLI with --validate-existing.

datasets.name: IndianaMap Hospital Locations 2023 — Marion County
datasets.purpose: Provides geocoded hospital facilities for the hospital-access service category.
datasets.source_organization: Indiana Geographic Information Office (IndianaMap), republishing HIFLD-derived data

license.name: Indiana Geographic Information Office limitation of warranties and liability
license.notes: Provided as-is; the user assumes risk and IGIO disclaims liability. Retain source attribution and SOURCE fields.

datasets.geographic_coverage: Hospital records whose COUNTY field is MARION
known_limitations: The item states that facilities absent from its source systems are not included.
It was republished in 2026 under a 2023 dataset title and may not represent current openings or closures.
Nursing homes and health centers are explicitly excluded.
datasets.manual_fallback: Open the IndianaMap item, export the layer to GeoJSON, retain records where COUNTY equals MARION, and save as hospital_locations_2023_marion.geojson.

datasets.name: USDA Historical SNAP Retailer Locator Data 2005–2025
datasets.purpose: Provides a federal fallback from which active SNAP-authorized supermarkets and grocery stores can be selected for later grocery-access analysis.
datasets.source_organization: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Service

license.name: U.S. federal public data; no dataset-specific license stated on source page
license.notes: Cite USDA FNS. The repository does not redistribute the production ZIP.

datasets.geographic_coverage: United States; later processing will filter Marion County, Indiana and active grocery-relevant store types
known_limitations: This is a fallback because no verified local or state grocery-location dataset with clear public access was found.
SNAP authorization is not equivalent to a complete inventory of grocery stores.
The historical file requires filtering by End Date and store type; convenience stores must not be treated automatically as full-service grocery access.
The source is current only through December 31, 2025.
datasets.manual_fallback: Open the USDA source page, download Historical SNAP Retailer Locator Data (.zip), and save the unmodified file as snap_retailers_2005_2025.zip in the configured cache.

datasets.name: 2025–2026 Indiana School Directory
datasets.purpose: Provides official public and accredited non-public school names and addresses for later school-access analysis.

license.name: Indiana government public record; no dataset-specific license stated
license.notes: Do not redistribute the workbook without confirming state terms; retain IDOE attribution and retrieval date.

datasets.geographic_coverage: State of Indiana; later processing will filter COUNTY_NAME equal to Marion
datasets.crs: Not applicable; workbook contains street addresses but no coordinates
known_limitations: The workbook contains addresses rather than coordinates and will require a documented geocoding step later.
Public schools and accredited non-public schools are stored on separate SCHL and NPSCHL sheets.
The file is a school-year snapshot and may not capture mid-year changes.
datasets.manual_fallback: Open the IDOE Data Center page, select 2025-2026 Indiana School Directory under General School Information, and save the workbook as indiana_school_directory_2025_2026.xlsx in the configured cache.

datasets.name: Library Locations of Indiana 2025
datasets.purpose: Provides Indiana State Library-maintained branch names, types, addresses, update fields, and point geometry for later library-access analysis.
datasets.source_organization: Indiana State Library, published by the Indiana Geographic Information Office (IndianaMap)

license.name: Indiana State Library / Indiana Geographic Information Office copyright and as-is service metadata
license.notes: The service identifies Indiana State Library and IGIO copyright. Cache locally, retain attribution, and confirm downstream republication terms before release.

datasets.geographic_coverage: State of Indiana; later processing will spatially select Marion County and apply a public-library inclusion rule
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 in requested GeoJSON; source layer reports Web Mercator auxiliary sphere (WKID 102100 / latest WKID 3857)
known_limitations: The statewide layer includes public, academic, school, special, and other library types; later ETL must define the public-service category explicitly.
The dataset was developed in May 2025 and may not reflect later openings, closures, or temporary service changes.
The official Indianapolis Public Library locations page remains the preferred local cross-check but its downloaded HTML did not contain the rendered address records during verification.
datasets.manual_fallback: Open the IndianaMap layer URL, choose Query, request all records with geometry and output spatial reference 4326, select GeoJSON, and save as indiana_library_locations_2025.geojson. Cross-check selected Indianapolis branches against https://www.indypl.org/locations.

datasets.name: Indianapolis Fire Department Stations
datasets.purpose: Provides official IFD station points for later fire-station proximity analysis.
datasets.source_organization: City of Indianapolis and Marion County, Indianapolis Fire Department

license.name: No explicit license supplied in ArcGIS service metadata
license.notes: Official publicly queryable service with City copyright text. Cache locally and confirm downstream republication terms before release.

datasets.geographic_coverage: Indianapolis Fire Department stations; does not automatically include every non-IFD department in Marion County
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 in requested GeoJSON; source service reports WKID 2244 / latest WKID 2965
known_limitations: This layer covers IFD stations; the same service exposes non-IFD stations separately and coverage parity must be evaluated before analysis.
No explicit update date or open-data license is supplied in the layer metadata.
datasets.manual_fallback: Open the source page URL, choose Query, request all records with geometry and output spatial reference 4326, select GeoJSON, and save as ifd_fire_stations.geojson.

datasets.name: 2020–2024 ACS 5-year Block Group Demographics
datasets.purpose: Provides total population, margins of error, and household vehicle availability inputs for later population-normalized accessibility indicators.

license.name: U.S. Census Bureau public data
license.notes: Cite the U.S. Census Bureau, ACS 2024 5-year release, variables, geography, and retrieval date.

datasets.geographic_coverage: All Census block groups in Marion County (state 18, county 097)
datasets.crs: Not applicable; tabular data join to TIGER/Line using state, county, tract, and block group codes
known_limitations: ACS estimates have sampling error; margins of error must remain visible in downstream interpretation.
The API returned a Missing Key HTML response during verification without a key, so automation requires a user-provided CENSUS_API_KEY even though the dataset is public.
Household vehicle availability is not a direct measure of individual transit dependence.
datasets.manual_fallback: Request a free Census API key at https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html and set CENSUS_API_KEY, or use data.census.gov to download ACS 2024 5-year detailed tables B01003 and B08201 for all Marion County block groups; preserve the original download and metadata in the raw cache.
